lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns posterior to the gills. The spots exhibit a regular spatial distribution with higher density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like lattice where blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal ridge lines along the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a dense constellation of smaller, high-luminance spots differing in scale and distribution from those on the main lateral flank.
